drivingQuestion: Why is a shetuki fit by Torah law?
outcomeNote: Rava's ruling and the opening of its reasoning; the reasoning continues in the next unit

segments.he: אֵלּוּ הֵן: שְׁתוּקִי – כֹּל שֶׁמַּכִּיר. אָמַר רָבָא: דְּבַר תּוֹרָה שְׁתוּקִי כָּשֵׁר. מַאי טַעְמָא – רוֹב כְּשֵׁרִים אֶצְלָהּ, וּמִיעוּט פְּסוּלִין אֶצְלָהּ.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «And these are» the last two categories: «A shetuki» is «any» person «who knows» the identity of his mother but does not know the identity of his father. «Rava says: By Torah law, a shetuki is fit» to enter the congregation. «What is the reason» for this? «Most are fit with regard to her,» i.e., most men are fit to engage in intercourse with an unmarried woman, «and» only «a minority are unfit with regard to» engaging in intercourse with «her.» There are few men who are related to a woman in a way that would render the offspring mamzerim.
